evidence.detail: Launcher.b(boolean) constructs rs/gui/C with itself plus the requested boolean and submits it through SwingUtilities.invokeLater.
run() obtains Launcher.i() JFrame and calls setResizable(requestedBoolean); no second mutation or unrelated state exists.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the Swing runnable that applies Launcher frame resizability.

evidence.detail: The class extends JPanel, initializes to the Launcher client dimension, uses BorderLayout and a black background.
Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E, initializes/starts the live rs/Client, then adds that Client component to this panel at BorderLayout.CENTER.
Launcher adds this panel to the main Swing content container beside the optional R145 ClientSidebarPanel, fixing it as the game-client/canvas host surface.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the black Swing host panel containing the live Client component.

evidence.detail: rs/gui/D stores only the owning Launcher plus four integer dimensions supplied at construction.
run() obtains the Launcher JFrame, applies the first width/height pair as setMinimumSize(Dimension), then applies the second pair through setSize(width,height).
